name: Chemical Bonding
overview: Both the oxygen atoms have octet in the valence shell. Electrons in valence shell (valence electrons) are responsible for the formation of bonds between atoms. Each atom in the F2 molecule has an octet of valence electrons.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Both the oxygen _____ have octet in the valence shell.
vsaq.answer: Both the oxygen atoms have octet in the valence shell.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Each atom in the F2 molecule has an octet of valence _____.
vsaq.answer: Each atom in the F2 molecule has an octet of valence electrons.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Chlorine has shortage of one electron to get octet in its _____ shell.
vsaq.answer: Chlorine has shortage of one electron to get octet in its valence shell.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Ammonia (NH3) molecule In ammonia molecule, three N – H single _____ bonds are present.
vsaq.answer: Ammonia (NH3) molecule In ammonia molecule, three N – H single covalent bonds are present.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Sodium chloride is formed from the _____ sodium and chlorine.
vsaq.answer: Sodium chloride is formed from the elements sodium and chlorine.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Formation of BeCl2 (Beryllium chloride) _____ Be has electronic configuration 1s2 2s2.
vsaq.answer: Formation of BeCl2 (Beryllium chloride) molecule Be has electronic configuration 1s2 2s2.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: When they are allowed to undergo chemical changes, they try to get _____ electronic configuration in the outer shells.
vsaq.answer: When they are allowed to undergo chemical changes, they try to get octet electronic configuration in the outer shells.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: These molecules are known as _____ deficient molecules.
vsaq.answer: These molecules are known as electron deficient molecules.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: After formation of (σ) bond the other bonds are formed due to the overlap of _____ side wise or laterally giving weaker π bonds.
vsaq.answer: After formation of (σ) bond the other bonds are formed due to the overlap of orbitals side wise or laterally giving weaker π bonds.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: As it forms three identical B-F _____ in BF3, it is suggested that excited ‘B’ atom undergoes hybridisation.
vsaq.answer: As it forms three identical B-F bonds in BF3, it is suggested that excited ‘B’ atom undergoes hybridisation.

mcqs.question: Select the word that correctly completes the idea. The _____ the overlapping of the orbitals that form the bond, the stronger will be the bond.

mcqs.subject: Physical Science

mcqs.question: Select the word that correctly completes the idea. There is an intermixing of 2s, 2px, 2py orbitals and their redistribution into _____ identical orbitals called sp2 hybrid orbitals.

mcqs.question: In Chemical Bonding, which option best completes this statement? The _____ of the NH3 molecule is triagonal pyramidal with N at the apex of the pyramid.

mcqs.subject: Physical Science

mcqs.question: Which term correctly completes this textbook-based statement? The electrostatic attractive force that keeps cation and anion _____ to form a new electrically neutral entity is called an ionic bond.

mcqs.subject: Physical Science

mcqs.question: Identify the missing concept in this chapter statement. The π bond _____ gives a weaker bond due to the lateral overlap of ‘p’ orbitals which is not to greater extent.
mcqs.explanation: The π bond overlap gives a weaker bond due to the lateral overlap of ‘p’ orbitals which is not to greater extent.
mcqs.subject: Physical Science

mcqs.question: Select the word that correctly completes the idea. Hybridisation is a phenomenon of intermixing of atomic orbitals of almost equal energy which are present in the outer _____ of the atom and their reshuffling or redistribution into the same number of orbitals but with equal properties like energy and shape.
mcqs.explanation: Hybridisation is a phenomenon of intermixing of atomic orbitals of almost equal energy which are present in the outer shells of the atom and their reshuffling or redistribution into the same number of orbitals but with equal properties like energy and shape.
mcqs.subject: Physical Science
